notes:
- **Archie Mobile shows notifications** for reminders, reports, new mail, and replies to what you
  sent from your phone, even when the app is closed. Turn them on in Archie Mobile, under Settings.
  What each one says is locked on this computer and opened only on your phone.
- **Close Archie's window and your agents keep working.** Archie opens at login with no window, and
  only quitting Archie switches it off.
- **A routine your computer slept through runs when it wakes**, and Archie says when a routine that
  has never run missed its time.
- **On Archie for Teams, teammates can use Archie Mobile.** Add someone with an Archie Mobile link
  and they join from it, with a conversation of their own, a Dashboard of their own, and the
  agent's lists, showing their own entries and the ones nobody is named on. A Telegram invite joins
  with one press too.
- **Ask what the team has been doing** and your agent tells you what each teammate asked. You can
  set a reminder for a teammate, and it reaches them in their own chat.
- **On Archie Mobile, press a list to see what is on it**, then add an entry, change one, or delete
  one. You can also add, change, or remove the people on an agent from your phone.
- **Each morning your agent sends a list of what is on for the day**, made for your line of work.
  After your first questions it says when the first one comes.
- **The first questions are fewer**, and a question of yours ends them. When a reply names an app you
  have not connected, a button under it opens where to connect it.
- **A spreadsheet dropped in the chat or opened from your mail goes on a card** that shows its rows
  before anything is added, and says which columns the list has no place for.
- **Your agent can write a first text to a new lead**, and says whether they agreed to texts. Archie
  copies it for you, and Archie Mobile opens Messages with it typed in.
- **Under a draft, a note names anything in it that nobody told your agent.** With sending off, a
  mail card is a draft to copy, with no Send button.
- **Undo all under a reply** takes back everything it saved.
- **Say Monday on a Monday and your agent asks which one you mean.** It says when a date it filled
  in is a guess, and asks before writing over a date you gave it.
- **Real estate deals have inspection, appraisal, and loan approval dates.** A lead with the same
  name, phone, or email as one on your lists is named as already there.
- **Ask what Archie costs or how much free credit is left** and the answer is exact. An add-on that
  needs your own AI account says what one usually costs and has a button to set it up.
- **A request to pass on new or changed wiring instructions is turned down every time**, before the
  AI is asked anything.
- **Pairing Archie Mobile no longer moves an agent off its chat app.** Archie Mobile is a box you
  tick beside it.
- **Fixed: the agent page could grow wider than the window.**
- **Fixed: mail waiting to be read could lose its cards if Archie restarted.**
- **Fixed: reconnecting your email could lose your signature and your shared calendar.**
